answer_1.quote: Auto-regressive models(ARM) are widely used for natural language generation(NLG) tasks, such as machine translation , dialogue response generation , image captioning and video description ... We evaluate the proposed models on two public datasets, i.e. the Chinese STC and the English Reddit dataset. ... We also conduct experiments on the WMT'14 English→German NMT dataset.
answer_1.outputs: Generated dialogue responses and machine translation sentences

answer_2.quote: Quantitative metrics contains traditional metrics, such as PPL and BLEU score, and Distinct metric ... We also evaluate each generated response by calculating BLEU score with all reference responses, and use the highest BLEU score to represent the quality of generated response.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, given 300 randomly sampled contexts and their responses which are generated by different models, three annotators (all CS majored students) are required to give the score of those context-response pairs, e.g. 3, 2, 1 means relevant, common and no-relevant, respectively, based on the coherence of the generated responses with respect to the contexts.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assign a score (3=relevant, 2=common, 1=no-relevant) based on the coherence of the response with the context.
